subject: [PATCH v1] fuse: don't launder folios of a bad inode

reviews.author: Miklos Szeredi
reviews.summary: Applied the patch, thanks for fixing this bug.
reviews.raw_body:
On Tue, 6 Oct 2026 at 12:51, Joanne Koong <joannelkoong@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> fuse_flush() and fuse_writepages() reject writing back dirty data for
> any inode that has been marked bad, but fuse_launder_folio() doesn't.

> Instead of trying to write back dirty data for the bad inode,
> fuse_launder_folio() should return -EIO.

Applied, thanks.

Miklos

2026-10-16.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the FUSE file system where dirty pages are not properly handled when an inode is marked bad. The problem occurs when a writeable file is closed and its inode is marked bad, causing subsequent invalidation to trigger a warning. The fix adds a check in fuse_launder_folio() to return -EIO if the inode is bad.
